test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Advanced Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: Lalit Kala Akademi inaugurated the 64th National Exhibition of Art with a historic push towards artist empowerment. What new feature was introduced in the 64th National Exhibition of Art?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Sale of award-winning artworks**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• 64th National Art Exhibition Opens in Delhi, Enables Artwork Sales.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The **64th National Exhibition of Art (NEA)** was inaugurated in **New Delhi** on **August 6, 2025**, by **Lalit Kala Akademi**.

 
 
• 
 
For the **first time**, **award-winning artworks will be available for sale**, empowering artists and promoting the **creative economy**.

 
 
• 
 
The exhibition showcases a fusion of **traditional, folk, tribal**, and **contemporary** art forms.

 
 
• 
 
Art forms featured:

 
 
• 
 
**Painting**

 
 
• 
 
**Sculpture**

 
 
• 
 
**Graphics**

 
 
• 
 
**Installation**

 
 
• 
 
**Photography**

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**20 artists** were awarded the prestigious **Lalit Kala Akademi Award** for excellence in **visual arts**.

 
 
• 
 
**Veteran artists** **Krishen Khanna**, **Ram V. Sutar**, and **Ira Chaudhari** were honoured for their **lifetime contributions**.

 
 
• 
 
Two books were launched:

 
 
• 
 
**64th NEA Exhibition Catalogue**

 
 
• 
 
**Printmaker for All Seasons**, celebrating **Padma Shri Shyam Sharma**.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
Venue: **Lalit Kala Akademi Galleries**, **Rabindra Bhavan**, New Delhi.

 
 
• 
 
**Lalit Kala Akademi**, India’s **national visual arts body**, was established on **August 5, 1954**.
